entries.nameEn: Microscopic observations and the development of cell theory

goal.zh: 区分所见结构、归纳结论和修正证据。
goal.en: Shared structures across tissues supported cell theory.

entries.sectionEn: Cells are the basic units of life

entries.nameEn: Observe cells with a high-power microscope

goal.zh: 视野、放大倍数与细胞形态的对应。
goal.en: High power narrows the field; adjust fine focus.

entries.nameEn: Observe chloroplasts and cytoplasmic streaming

goal.zh: 叶绿体的形态分布和持续运动。
goal.en: Follow the ringed chloroplast while the cell wall stays fixed.

entries.nameEn: Detect sugars, lipids and proteins in biological tissues

goal.zh: 试剂选择、加热和显色结果；三类检测分别演示。
goal.en: Add Biuret A before B; a protein sample turns violet.

entries.nameEn: Overton’s cell-permeability experiments

goal.zh: 观察证据和成分推断的区别。
goal.en: Under matched conditions, substances differ in membrane permeability.

entries.nameEn: Spreading lipids extracted from red blood cells

goal.zh: 面积比例支持双分子层假说。
goal.en: With the same molecules, an ideal monolayer occupies twice the original area.

entries.nameEn: Surface tension and the membrane-protein hypothesis

goal.zh: 测量与推断之间的关系，不能把旧假说当现行结构。
goal.en: Protein adsorption can lower interfacial tension without uniquely specifying membrane structure.

entries.nameEn: Three-layer membrane contrast in electron microscopy

goal.zh: 成像证据能说明什么、不能说明什么。
goal.en: Dark–light–dark contrast is image evidence, not a direct molecular label.

entries.nameEn: Fluorescent markers in mouse–human cell fusion

goal.zh: 膜蛋白位置随时间变化与膜流动性。
goal.en: Markers retain their origins while changing positions, supporting membrane fluidity.

entries.nameEn: Build a biological membrane model from reused materials

goal.zh: 流动镶嵌结构及静态模型的局限。
goal.en: Preserve orientation and embedding relationships, and state the model’s limits.

entries.nameEn: The fluid mosaic structure of cell membranes

goal.zh: 细胞膜的流动镶嵌结构
goal.en: Hydrophilic heads face water, tails face inward and some proteins span the bilayer.

entries.nameEn: Osmosis in a semipermeable funnel

goal.zh: 浓度差、半透膜与液面变化，区分净流与双向移动。
goal.en: Hydrostatic pressure opposes osmosis, so the liquid does not rise indefinitely.

entries.chapterEn: Transport into and out of cells

entries.nameEn: Diffusion of red ink in water

goal.zh: 扩散与跨半透膜渗透的区别。
goal.en: Ink spreads from a local concentration while total solute remains constant.

entries.chapterEn: Transport into and out of cells

entries.nameEn: Red cells in solutions of different concentrations

goal.zh: 净水流方向、膨胀和皱缩。
goal.en: Hypotonic solution causes swelling, hypertonic solution shrinkage; red cells lack a supporting wall.

entries.chapterEn: Transport into and out of cells

entries.nameEn: Investigate water uptake and loss in plant cells

goal.zh: 质壁分离与复原的可逆过程，细胞壁与原生质层分开。
goal.en: A viable cell takes up water after replacement with fresh water and approaches the wall again.

entries.chapterEn: Transport into and out of cells

entries.nameEn: Tracer evidence and functional identification of water channels

goal.zh: 异常运输速率如何提出并检验通道假说；概要。
goal.en: Aquaporins increase water permeability without powering uphill water transport.

entries.chapterEn: Transport into and out of cells

entries.nameEn: Simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion and active transport

goal.zh: 自由扩散、协助扩散与主动运输
goal.en: An ATP-driven pump can raise an already higher intracellular concentration.

entries.chapterEn: Transport into and out of cells

entries.nameEn: Artificial synthesis of crystalline bovine insulin

goal.zh: 分子组成与活性验证；不补写教材没有的实验步骤。
goal.en: Structure must be supported by an independent activity test, not appearance alone.

entries.sectionEn: Proteins are the main performers of life functions

entries.nameEn: Amino-acid condensation and protein spatial structure

goal.zh: 氨基酸脱水缩合与蛋白质空间结构
goal.en: Two disulfides join A and B; a third joins two positions within A.

entries.sectionEn: Proteins are the main performers of life functions

entries.nameEn: Isotope tracing of secretory protein synthesis and transport

goal.zh: 连续追踪而非孤立细胞器示意。
goal.en: Fusion joins the vesicle lumen to the exterior and releases its cargo.

entries.nameEn: Construct a three-dimensional eukaryotic-cell model

goal.zh: 结构比例及膜系统连接；属于建模实践。
goal.en: Preserve membranes, compartments and connections before choosing colors and materials.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Synthesize or redesign chromosomes and test cellular viability

goal.zh: 人工合成基因组与已有细胞系统的关系；只有研究概要。
goal.en: After changing DNA organization, growth, reproduction and function still need testing.

entries.nameEn: Nuclear transfer and trait origins in a cloned cow

goal.zh: 区分核供体、卵细胞供体和代孕个体。
goal.en: The nucleus, egg cytoplasm and gestational environment have distinct origins.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Nuclear transplantation between dark and pale axolotls

goal.zh: 细胞核与遗传性状的联系。
goal.en: A dark axolotl nucleus in an enucleated pale donor egg produces dark offspring in this comparison.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Constriction of a fertilized newt egg

goal.zh: 核的有无与细胞分裂、发育的对应。
goal.en: The initially enucleated half starts division after receiving a nucleus.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Amoeba cutting, enucleation and nuclear replacement

goal.zh: 可逆干预形成细胞核控制生命活动的证据。
goal.en: An enucleated fragment can briefly digest existing food, but sustained activity needs nucleus–cytoplasm cooperation.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Acetabularia grafting and nuclear transplantation

goal.zh: 新帽形态与细胞核来源的关系。
goal.en: The regenerated cap primarily follows the basal nucleus’s origin.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Key difficulties in somatic-cell cloning of macaques

goal.zh: 将技术干预与成功率限制联系；教材只给概要。
goal.en: Enucleation, activation and reprogramming matter; historical success is not universal success.

entries.sectionEn: Structure and function of the nucleus

entries.nameEn: Nuclear transfer from Xenopus intestinal epithelium

goal.zh: 细胞全能性与细胞核遗传信息完整性的区别。
goal.en: A differentiated intestinal nucleus can support broad development in a suitable egg environment.

entries.nameEn: Spallanzani’s digestion experiment in an eagle stomach

goal.zh: 排除机械研磨解释，提出化学消化假说。
goal.en: Gastric fluid enters the cage and the meat disappears.

entries.nameEn: Comparing hydrogen peroxide decomposition under different conditions

goal.zh: 反应速率、变量控制和酶的高效性。
goal.en: Equal substrate amounts reveal different rates, not different theoretical yields.

entries.nameEn: Buchner’s cell-free fermentation experiment

goal.zh: 活细胞与细胞提取物作用的区分。
goal.en: Cell-free yeast extract retains the catalytic system needed for fermentation.

entries.nameEn: Sumner’s isolation and identification of urease crystals

goal.zh: 分离、功能检测和物质鉴定组成证据链。
goal.en: Protein identity and urea-hydrolyzing activity require separate verification.

entries.nameEn: Amylase action on starch and sucrose

goal.zh: 底物变化与酶的专一性。
goal.en: With the same amylase, starch yields detectable reducing products.

entries.nameEn: Conditions affecting enzyme activity

goal.zh: 反应速度随条件变化，区分低温抑制与高温失活。
goal.en: Cold inhibition recovers; severe heat damage persists in this model.

entries.nameEn: ATP structure and energy coupling

goal.zh: ATP的结构与能量转换
goal.en: ATP hydrolysis couples to energy-requiring processes; ADP can regenerate ATP.

entries.sectionEn: ATP: the energy currency of cells

entries.nameEn: Investigating modes of cellular respiration in yeast

goal.zh: 氧气条件、气体流路和产物检测的对应。
goal.en: Test carbon dioxide and ethanol separately; residual glucose interferes with the ethanol assay.

entries.sectionEn: Principles and applications of cellular respiration

entries.nameEn: Matter and energy pathways in aerobic respiration and fermentation

goal.zh: 有氧呼吸、无氧呼吸的物质与能量路径
goal.en: Yeast forms ethanol and carbon dioxide; lactate fermentation releases no carbon dioxide.

entries.sectionEn: Principles and applications of cellular respiration

entries.nameEn: Extraction and separation of pigments from green leaves

goal.zh: 色素溶解与不同迁移速度形成四条色带。
goal.en: The solvent front rises while four pigment bands follow different distances.

entries.nameEn: Absorption spectra of chloroplast pigments

goal.zh: 透过光与吸收光区别，叶绿素和类胡萝卜素的差异。
goal.en: The three solution spectra differ and do not directly measure whole-leaf photosynthetic efficiency.

entries.nameEn: Engelmann’s localized-illumination experiment

goal.zh: 需氧细菌作为放氧位置的指示。
goal.en: Aerobic bacteria gather near illuminated chloroplast regions.

entries.nameEn: Engelmann’s dispersed-spectrum experiment

goal.zh: 光谱与光合作用放氧的关联。
goal.en: More bacteria gather near blue-violet and red illumination.

entries.nameEn: The Hill reaction

goal.zh: 水光解放氧与糖合成可以区分。
goal.en: Isolated chloroplasts can evolve oxygen with light and a suitable electron acceptor.

entries.nameEn: Ruben and Kamen’s oxygen-isotope tracing

goal.zh: 光合作用释放氧气中的氧元素来源。
goal.en: The oxygen label in water enters evolved O₂.

entries.nameEn: Arnon’s chloroplast photophosphorylation research

goal.zh: 光能转化与ATP合成的证据，缺完整操作过程。
goal.en: Illuminated chloroplasts can convert ADP and phosphate into ATP.

entries.nameEn: Coupling light reactions and carbon reactions

goal.zh: 光反应和碳反应的物质能量联系
goal.en: Thylakoid reactions supply ATP and NADPH consumed by stromal carbon reactions.

entries.nameEn: Calvin’s carbon-isotope tracing

goal.zh: 碳从无机物进入有机物；不补成教材未给的完整实验流程。
goal.en: The label from ¹⁴CO₂ enters three-carbon compounds and later sugars.

entries.nameEn: Investigating environmental effects on photosynthesis

goal.zh: 光照、产氧与叶片上浮的关系，控制其他变量。
goal.en: Matched sets of ten discs rise as light changes net gas accumulation.

entries.nameEn: Chromosome behavior during mitosis

goal.zh: 有丝分裂的染色体行为
goal.en: Plants form a cell plate; animal cells divide through a cleavage furrow.

entries.nameEn: Mathematical model of cell surface area and volume

goal.zh: 细胞表面积与体积关系的数学模型
goal.en: Larger cubes have less surface area per unit volume.

entries.nameEn: Observing mitosis in root-tip meristem cells

goal.zh: 由固定装片的不同细胞辨认时期，不能误演为同一死细胞继续分裂。
goal.en: The field remains fixed while observation and stage counting move between cells.

entries.nameEn: Culturing carrot phloem cells

goal.zh: 高度分化植物细胞的全能性。
goal.en: Differentiated plant cells can express totipotency under suitable conditions.

entries.nameEn: Comparing lung fibroblast proliferation from different age sources

goal.zh: 供体年龄和细胞分裂潜力的关系。
goal.en: The textbook comparison does not predict human lifespan.

entries.nameEn: Nuclear and cytoplasmic exchange between young and old cells

goal.zh: 区分细胞核和细胞质对衰老的影响。
goal.en: Original studies show that a young nucleus does not guarantee vigorous proliferation.

entries.nameEn: Tracing programmed cell death in Caenorhabditis elegans

goal.zh: 细胞谱系与程序性死亡；属于研究概要。
goal.en: Loss of death-execution genes can preserve cells normally destined to die.

entries.nameEn: Mendel’s pea crosses with one pair of contrasting traits

goal.zh: 亲本、配子与子代比例之间的推理。
goal.en: Selfing the first-generation hybrid yields three genotypes and two phenotypes.

entries.nameEn: Simulating phenotypic segregation ratios

goal.zh: 随机抽样、样本量与3∶1表型比例。
goal.en: Random samples fluctuate; three to one is a probability prediction.

entries.nameEn: A test cross for one pair of contrasting traits

goal.zh: 以新实验检验假说。
goal.en: A heterozygote crossed with a recessive homozygote predicts equal phenotypes.

entries.nameEn: Mendel’s pea crosses with two pairs of contrasting traits

goal.zh: 两对性状独立分离与自由组合的数量关系。
goal.en: Independent assortment and random fertilization generate nine to three to three to one.

entries.nameEn: A test cross for two pairs of contrasting traits

goal.zh: 1∶1∶1∶1的预测及验证。
goal.en: A double-recessive tester reveals the hybrid’s gamete classes in its offspring.

entries.nameEn: Observing meiosis in grasshopper spermatocyte preparations

goal.zh: 区分同源染色体分离与姐妹染色单体分离。
goal.en: A cell in a fixed preparation does not continue dividing.

entries.nameEn: Modeling chromosome changes during meiosis

goal.zh: 配子多样性的三个模型路径；不冒充显微实拍。
goal.en: Independent assortment changes combinations among gametes.

entries.nameEn: Sutton’s observations of grasshopper chromosomes

goal.zh: 类比建立基因与染色体平行关系的假说。
goal.en: Pairing, segregation and recombination suggest chromosomes can carry inherited factors.

entries.nameEn: Meiosis, crossing over, independent assortment and fertilization

goal.zh: 减数分裂与受精作用
goal.en: Egg and sperm each contribute one set, restoring the diploid complement.

entries.nameEn: Morgan’s white-eye fly crosses and test crosses

goal.zh: X连锁假说怎样解释并预测性别相关表型。
goal.en: A white-eyed female crossed with a red-eyed male predicts red daughters and white sons.

entries.nameEn: Dalton’s color observations and red–green color-vision pedigrees

goal.zh: 观察和系谱证据区别于干预实验。
goal.en: An affected father can transmit his X through a daughter to her son.

entries.nameEn: Surveying inherited conditions in a population

goal.zh: 家系信息与人群发病率统计的区别。
goal.en: Different sample sizes require weighting, and each person is counted once.

entries.nameEn: Griffith’s pneumococcal transformation experiment

goal.zh: 混合组证据支持转化因子存在。
goal.en: Live S bacteria recovered from the mixture produce S descendants.

entries.sectionEn: DNA is the main genetic material

entries.nameEn: Avery’s identification of the transforming principle

goal.zh: 去除特定成分的减法对照。
goal.en: Activity remains after protease, RNase or lipase, but is lost after DNase.

entries.sectionEn: DNA is the main genetic material

entries.nameEn: Hershey and Chase’s bacteriophage infection experiment

goal.zh: 核酸和蛋白质不同去向及遗传物质推断。
goal.en: Progeny evidence supports a hereditary role for DNA, with experimental qualifications.

entries.sectionEn: DNA is the main genetic material

entries.nameEn: X-ray diffraction and construction of the DNA double-helix model

goal.zh: 多种证据对结构方案的约束。
goal.en: Standard A–T and G–C pairs each combine one two-ring base with one single-ring base.

entries.nameEn: Constructing a DNA double-helix model

goal.zh: 骨架方向、碱基配对和双螺旋空间关系。
goal.en: Real coordinates retain exterior backbones, interior bases and unequal grooves.

entries.nameEn: Meselson and Stahl’s evidence for semiconservative DNA replication

goal.zh: 一代与二代条带区分复制假说。
goal.en: Original heavy strands A and B do not multiply; their fraction among duplexes falls.

entries.nameEn: The molecular process of semiconservative DNA replication

goal.zh: DNA半保留复制的分子过程
goal.en: DNA replaces RNA primers and nicks are joined; each daughter retains one parental strand.

entries.nameEn: Crick’s frameshift experiments and the triplet code

goal.zh: 三个碱基一组与连续非重叠阅读的证据。
goal.en: A net change of three bases restores the downstream frame, not necessarily protein function.

entries.nameEn: Nirenberg and Matthaei’s poly-U experiment

goal.zh: 人工RNA序列和合成肽链的对应。
goal.en: The original assay measured labeled amino-acid incorporation, not visible peptide chains.

entries.nameEn: Transcription and translation of genetic information

goal.zh: 转录和翻译
goal.en: A release factor recognizes the stop codon and releases the peptide from tRNA.

entries.nameEn: Comparing DNA and mRNA detection in chicken cell types

goal.zh: 基因相同不等于表达相同；材料为检测数据分析。
goal.en: The genes are present in every cell type, but the three assayed mRNAs have different detection patterns.

entries.nameEn: Epigenetic evidence from Linaria flowers and agouti mice

goal.zh: DNA序列与表达调控的区别，正文资料并非学生操作。
goal.en: Aᵛʸ/a mice can differ in coat color as upstream methylation affects ectopic expression.

entries.nameEn: Developmental temperature and vestigial-wing traits

goal.zh: 环境影响性状与基因改变的区别。
goal.en: Their offspring raised at 25 °C still show vestigial wings.

entries.nameEn: Muller’s X-ray induction of mutations in Drosophila

goal.zh: 诱变频率变化；仅简述研究，不补写条件。
goal.en: A tracked recessive-lethal X changes which offspring classes survive.

entries.nameEn: Analyzing the textbook smoking and lung-cancer case-control data

goal.zh: 相关性、对照选择和因果结论的边界。
goal.en: 63.16% and 39.06% are smoking proportions within the sampled groups, not cancer risks among smokers.

entries.nameEn: Cold-induced chromosome-number changes in plant root tips

goal.zh: 纺锤体受抑与染色体数目加倍的联系。
goal.en: Garlic or onion normally has 16 chromosomes; a doubled example has 32, counted by centromeres.

entries.nameEn: Chromosome-number and structural variation

goal.zh: 染色体数目与结构变异
goal.en: Inversion reverses a segment; translocation moves material between nonhomologous chromosomes.

entries.nameEn: Fossil, anatomical, embryological and molecular evidence for common ancestry

goal.zh: 证据类型相互补充，不能包装成一个湿实验。
goal.en: Differences in a homologous protein add evidence without serving as a universal clock.

entries.nameEn: Modeling natural selection and changing allele frequencies

goal.zh: 选择压力如何改变等位基因频率；模型假设需明示。
goal.en: The model’s second year has 11, 22 and 63 individuals, totaling 96, with S near 23%.

entries.nameEn: Investigating antibiotic selection with disk-growth comparisons

goal.zh: 选择已有变异与抑菌圈变化，不能说抗生素定向产生耐药突变。
goal.en: Selecting an existing clone can change a descendant plate, but zones need not shrink in every round.

entries.nameEn: Geographic isolation, reproductive isolation and speciation

goal.zh: 隔离与物种形成
goal.en: Whether reunited populations produce fertile offspring requires independent reproductive evidence.
